items.title: PostgreSQL 18 Query Optimization: A Free 199-Page Book
The future is Postgres
items.blurb: Craig Kerstiens returns to talk about the ever-expanding world of Postgres: a deliberately boring core, a thriving extension ecosystem, and pg_lake bringing DuckDB and Iceberg into the mix.

items.title: Spring News Roundup: First Release Candidates of Boot, Framework, Data, Security, Modulith, AI
items.blurb: There was a flurry of activity during the week of October 19th, 2026, highlighting: first release candidates of: Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Spring Data, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring for GraphQL, Spring Session, Spring…

items.title: PingCAP Breach Exposes Customer Records and Source Code
items.blurb: PingCAP recently confirmed unauthorized access to its internal systems and the theft of source code and customer-related data.

items.title: CSIRO Uses Serverless Architecture to Query 100x More Genomic Variants on AWS
items.blurb: CSIRO has developed Serverless Beacon, a serverless architecture for querying genomic variants without copying VCF files into a central database.
